items.title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
items.title_zh: S-Mind：内化多视图几何以实现空间智能
items.description: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.
items.description_zh: 随着多模态大型语言模型 (MLLM) 进入物理世界，空间智能（即通过视觉观察推理 3D 空间的能力）变得至关重要。除了感知每个视图之外，它还依赖于人类认知的两个基石：将多个视图融合成一个连贯的 3D 场景，并随着推理的展开，在心理上将该场景转换为新的视角。然而，我们的空间探测表明，即使在空间微调之后，MLLM 在很大程度上缺乏这两种功能。因此，我们提出了 S-Mind，它通过一组紧凑的空间标记将多视图几何内部化在 MLLM 中。它监督这些令牌来保存融合的 3D 场景，并重新发出它们，以从推理采用的每个角度重新表达该场景。在四个空间基准上，S-Mind 将其 Qwen3.5 主干提升了高达 22.26 点，并在平均准确度上超越了 GPT-6-Astra (+0.45)、Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97) 和 GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) 等前沿通用模型。此外，相同的探针证实它获得了这两种能力，融合和转换准确率分别达到 65.11% 和 82.17%，而基线最多为 16.02% 和 37.28%。据推断，S-Mind 的运行速度比同一主干上基于工具的代理快约 100 倍。在训练过程中通过这些空间令牌灌输，空间能力成为骨干网固有的，即使在令牌被扣留的情况下也仍然存在，为 MLLM 中的空间智能提供了一条有希望的道路。
items.authors: Muxin Fu, Peike Yu, Guibin Zhang, Wenrui Zhou, Runze Liu, Lang Feng, Fuchao Yang, Feng Chen, Yixuan Li, Mengao Zhang, Shiying Zhang, Wen Shen, Ling Pan, Shuicheng Yan, Bo An

items.title: LoopedWAM: Looped World Action Models for Elastic Inference
items.title_zh: LoopedWAM：用于弹性推理的循环世界动作模型
items.description: World action models (WAMs) couple generative video modeling with robotic action prediction but typically require large video and action transformers, limiting deployment efficiency. We present LoopedWAM, a compact WAM that recurrently applies a shared six-block core in each expert, executing 30 transformer layers while storing only 12 blocks per expert. To account for their asymmetric inference costs, the video and action experts can operate at different depths: visual features are computed once per query, whereas action computation repeats at every sampling step. We further propose elastic self-distillation, which trains a single elastic checkpoint, LoopedWAM-E, across action-depth and sampling-step budgets. With only 0.58B policy parameters and no robot pretraining, LoopedWAM achieves 96.1% success on LIBERO, 91.9% on RoboTwin 2.0, and 52.2% on RoboCasaGR1, while using 7.4times less peak GPU memory than Fast-WAM under matched inference measurements. On LIBERO, LoopedWAM-E achieves 96.0% success in 27.6 ms or 95.2% in 24.7 ms on an H100, providing multiple accuracy-latency operating points from a single checkpoint; with two sampling steps and four action loops, it stays within 0.5 points of LoopedWAM on all three benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate that weight-shared depth preserves competitive performance, while aggressive action-depth reduction requires explicit budget-aware training. On a real AgileX PiPER arm, LoopedWAM succeeds in 71.3% of 80 trials across four tasks.
items.description_zh: 世界动作模型 (WAM) 将生成视频建模与机器人动作预测结合起来，但通常需要大型视频和动作转换器，从而限制了部署效率。我们推出了 LoopedWAM，这是一种紧凑的 WAM，它在每个 Expert 中循环应用共享的六块核心，执行 30 个转换器层，同时每个 Expert 只存储 12 个块。为了解决不对称推理成本，视频和动作专家可以在不同的深度进行操作：每个查询计算一次视觉特征，而动作计算在每个采样步骤重复。我们进一步提出弹性自蒸馏，它跨动作深度和采样步骤预算训练单个弹性检查点 LoopedWAM-E。仅 0.58B 策略参数且无需机器人预训练，LoopedWAM 在 LIBERO 上取得了 96.1% 的成功率，在 RoboTwin 2.0 上取得了 91.9% 的成功率，在 RoboCasaGR1 上取得了 52.2% 的成功率，而在匹配的推理测量下，使用的峰值 GPU 内存比 Fast-WAM 少了 7.4 倍。在 LIBERO 上，LoopedWAM-E 在 27.6 毫秒内实现了 96.0% 的成功率，在 H100 上在 24.7 毫秒内实现了 95.2% 的成功率，从单个检查点提供了多个精度-延迟操作点；通过两个采样步骤和四个动作循环，它在所有三个基准测试中都与 LoopedWAM 保持在 0.5 分以内。消融表明，重量共享深度可以保持竞争表现，而积极减少动作深度则需要明确的预算意识培训。在真正的 AgileX PiPER 手臂上，LoopedWAM 在四项任务的 80 次试验中取得了 71.3% 的成功。
items.authors: Anh Dao, Xinxin Liu, Hang Yu, Jeffrey A Chan Santiago, Yuzhang Shang

items.title: RoomTokens: Masked Diffusion over Structured Tokens for Indoor Scene Synthesis
items.title_zh: RoomTokens：用于室内场景合成的结构化令牌的掩蔽扩散
items.description: Generating 3D indoor scenes requires a representation that captures object semantics, instance identity, height structure, and orientation while respecting room geometry. Methods that model scenes as sequences of object vectors learn spatial constraints implicitly, leaving collisions and boundary violations to losses or post-processing; semantic-map methods make occupancy explicit, but collapse instance and directional structure. We introduce RoomTokens, a sliced structured-token representation in which each token stores semantic class, instance-color identity, and facing field. This representation allows a scene to be generated as a discrete grid while preserving cues for instance grouping, orientation estimation, and 3D extent prediction. To learn the RoomToken distribution, we propose MDIRT (Masked Diffusion over RoomTokens), a masked discrete diffusion model that denoises semantic/instance-color/facing channels jointly with a shared cross-slice backbone. Architectural tokens are clamped as explicit floor- plan constraints, so the model samples furniture layouts that respect room geometry while retaining instance and object-attribute structure. Experiments on 3D-FRONT show that RoomTokens with MDIRT improve layout fidelity and physical consistency over sequence/vector- and map-based methods, suggesting structured spatial tokens as a practical choice for discrete 3D scene synthesis.
items.description_zh: 生成 3D 室内场景需要一种能够捕获对象语义、实例标识、高度结构和方向的表示，同时尊重房间几何形状。将场景建模为对象向量序列的方法隐式学习空间约束，将碰撞和边界违规留给损失或后处理；语义映射方法使占用变得明确，但折叠了实例和方向结构。我们引入了 RoomTokens，一种切片结构化令牌表示，其中每个令牌存储语义类、实例颜色标识和面向字段。这种表示允许将场景生成为离散网格，同时保留实例分组、方向估计和 3D 范围预测的线索。为了学习 RoomToken 分布，我们提出了 MDIRT（RoomTokens 上的掩模扩散），这是一种掩模离散扩散模型，它与共享的跨切片主干联合对语义/实例颜色/面向通道进行去噪。建筑标记被限制为明确的平面图约束，因此模型对尊重房间几何形状的家具布局进行采样，同时保留实例和对象属性结构。 3D-FRONT 上的实验表明，与基于序列/矢量和地图的方法相比，具有 MDIRT 的 RoomToken 提高了布局保真度和物理一致性，表明结构化空间令牌是离散 3D 场景合成的实用选择。

items.title: LeadVLA: Learning Follower-Aware Route Execution for Robot Leading
items.title_zh: LeadVLA：学习跟随者感知的机器人引导路线执行
items.description: Robot leading requires executing a route while continuously adapting to a designated follower. Existing robot-leading systems often mediate follower understanding and physical route execution through explicit states, planners, or modular interfaces; directly learning this coupling through end-to-end trajectory prediction can instead entangle route execution with follower response. We introduce LeadVLA, a structured multimodal policy that preserves the route as an explicit Path reference while learning a Pace for route progress and a Residual for local follower- and scene-conditioned adaptation. To make this problem trainable and measurable, we develop LeadInfra, a configurable Unreal Engine-based closed-loop data-generation infrastructure from which we instantiate an approximately 4M-sample training corpus, and LeadBench, a standardized benchmark with 108 fully held-out closed-loop episodes. LeadVLA achieves the highest task success (39.6%) among evaluated robot policies on LeadBench while maintaining strong route fidelity and follower responsiveness, and transfers to unseen real-world environments without real-world policy fine-tuning. Project Page: https://louiszengCN.github.io/LeadVLA_PAGE/
items.description_zh: 机器人引导需要执行一条路线，同时不断适应指定的跟随者。现有的机器人主导系统通常通过明确的状态、规划器或模块化接口来调节跟随者的理解和物理路线的执行；通过端到端轨迹预测直接学习这种耦合可以使路线执行与跟随者响应纠缠在一起。我们引入了 LeadVLA，这是一种结构化的多模式策略，它将路线保留为显式路径参考，同时学习路线进度的 Pace 和本地跟随者和场景条件适应的 Residual。为了使这个问题可训练和可测量，我们���发了 LeadInfra，一个可配置的基于虚幻引擎的闭环数据生成基础设施，我们从中实例化了大约 400 万样本的训练语料库，以及 LeadBench，一个具有 108 个完全保留的闭环片段的标准化基准。 LeadVLA 在 LeadBench 上评估的机器人策略中取得了最高的任务成功率 (39.6%)，同时保持了强大的路线保真度和跟随者响应能力，并且无需实际策略微调即可转移到未见过的现实环境。项目页面：https://louiszengCN.github.io/LeadVLA_PAGE/
items.authors: Tianle Zeng, Hanjing Ye, Bingyi Xia, Yuchen Zhou, Zibo Zhang, Yufei Huang, Yonggen Ling, Hong Zhang

items.title: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
items.title_zh: EvoViM：用于通过延迟查询进行探索的递归自我进化视觉代理
items.description: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. We evaluate EvoViM with three multimodal models on six tasks covering visual matching, spatial recall, and sequential decision-making, including three tasks with deferred queries. Across the six tasks, EvoViM improves the average score over AutoMem, the strongest baseline in the main comparison, by 31.3-47.6 points on held-out episodes. Programs written once from the initial environment instructions perform substantially worse, highlighting the value of interaction experience in shaping how visual evidence is retained and used. Code and dataset are available at https://evovim.github.io/.
items.description_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）代理在面向任务的环境中表现出了有前途的能力。然而，当查询被推迟到探索之后时，他们仍然会遇到困难，这要求他们在知道哪些细节重要之前保留视觉证据。我们介绍了 EvoViM，这是一种递归自我进化框架，其中冻结的多模态模型将其自身的交互体验转变为一个用于记忆和技能的视觉程序。该程序保留图像并直接在像素上进行计算，其操作决定如何在每个任务中使用这些证据。在记忆进化过程中，同一模型将其视觉轨迹中的失败追溯到丢失或误用证据的操作，并对其进行修改。它还重写了指导后续修订的注释和分析工具，然后以早期发现为基础并跳过已经失败的更改。我们使用三个多模态模型对涵盖视觉匹配、空间回忆和顺序决策的六项任务（包括具有延迟查询的三项任务）的 EvoViM 进行评估。在六项任务中，EvoViM 的平均得分比主要比较中最强的基线 AutoMem 的平均得分提高了 31.3-47.6 分。根据初始环境指令编写的程序的性能要差��多，这凸显了交互体验在塑造视觉证据如何保留和使用方面的价值。代码和数据集可在 https://evovim.github.io/ 获取。
items.authors: Xinyu Cao, Tianjie Ju, Zhuosheng Zhang

items.title: LUCID: Statistically Grounded Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning Evaluation
items.title_zh: LUCID：基于统计的 LLM 推理评估自我修正
items.description: Cheap language-model raters grade chain-of-thought reasoning at scale, yet systematic step-rating errors can skew reasoning audits and solution rankings. We introduce LUCID (Loop for Unbiased Calibration via Inference-time Diagnosis), which pairs prompt self-correction with Design-based Supervised Learning (DSL). Without retraining or weight access, LUCID calibrates binary step ratings by aligning predicted and expert soundness rates. From a small expert-labeled set, LUCID summarizes rater bias in plain text and prompts the rater to re-grade unseen steps. For example, on PRM800K, GPT-5-mini grades too strictly, under-rating computation, verification, and late-trace steps most acutely. In one pass, LUCID shrinks GPT-5-mini's calibration gap from 7.8 to 0.9 percentage points in absolute predicted-expert rate difference. LUCID also halves false alarms (sound steps rated unsound) and lifts error-detection F1 on unsound steps by 32%. LUCID retains these gains with 1,000 diagnostic steps or overall-gap feedback alone. The loop also transfers across models and domains: it applies GPT-5-mini's bias profile to lift GLM-5.2's PRM800K accuracy, and it narrows calibration gaps for overly strict but capable raters across math, science, web, and logic benchmarks. Because prompt feedback shifts thresholds without improving class-balanced sound/unsound discrimination, LUCID filters re-grading with pre-/post-checks that skip already calibrated raters and roll back ineffective passes. Finally, we reuse that expert set with raw corpus ratings in DSL for calibration and regression debiasing, and apply DSL to pair-labeled steps for sound-step transitions. DSL's out-of-fold soundness probabilities lift best-of-K selection to match expert labels, while its doubly-robust estimators beat expert-only regression fits at small budgets and cut sound-step transition error by nearly two-thirds.
items.description_zh: 廉价的语言模型评估者对思维链推理进行大规模评分，但系统性的分级错误可能会扭曲推理审核和解决方案排名。我们引入了 LUCID（通过推理时间诊断进行无偏校准的循环），它将快速自我校正与基于设计的监督学习 (DSL) 结合起来。无需重新训练或权重访问，LUCID 通过调整预测健全率和专家健全率来校准二元步评级。 LUCID 从一小部分专家标记的集合中以纯文本形式总结评估者偏差，并提示评估者重新对未见过的步骤进行评分。例如，在 PRM800K 上，GPT-5-mini 评分过��严格，严重低估了计算、验证和后期跟踪步骤。在一次通过中，LUCID 将 GPT-5-mini 的绝对预测专家速率差异的校准差距从 7.8 个百分点缩小到 0.9 个百分点。 LUCID 还将误报（声音步骤评级为不健全）减少了一半，并将不健全步骤的错误检测 F1 提高了 32%。 LUCID 仅通过 1,000 个诊断步骤或整体差距反馈就保留了这些成果。该循环还可以跨模型和领域进行传输：它应用 GPT-5-mini 的偏差配置文件来提升 GLM-5.2 的 PRM800K 精度，并缩小数学、科学、网络和逻辑基准方面过于严格但有能力的评估者的校准差距。由于即时反馈会改变阈值，而不会改善类别平衡的声音/不声音辨别力，因此 LUCID 通过预/后检查过滤重新评分，跳过已经校准的评分者并回滚无效的通过。最后，我们在 DSL 中重用该专家集和原始语料库评级，以进行校准和回归去偏，并将 DSL 应用于成对标记步骤以实现声音步骤转换。 DSL 的 out-of-fold 稳健性概率提升了 best-of-K 选择以匹配专家标签，而其双鲁棒估计器在小预算下击败了仅专家回归拟合，并将声音步转换误差减少了近三分之二。
items.authors: Satiyabooshan Murugaboopathy, Adel Daoud, Connor T. Jerzak

items.title: Context-Grounded Skill Internalization for Vision-Language Agents
items.title_zh: 视觉语言代理的基于情境的技能内化
items.description: Skill internalization offers a way for agents to learn useful behaviors from skills and use them without explicit guidance in context at inference time. A common approach is to generate demonstration trajectories with the skill in context and then fine-tune the same model on its own trajectories with the skill removed. However, this leads to the problem that the model may learn to reference the removed skill, which we named as context misalignment (CoMi). In this work, we first analyze agent behaviors related to CoMi under this common pipeline. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ARC-AGI-1, skill-removed fine-tuning consistently results in CoMi: 12.2-46.0% of test trajectories reference the removed skill. To address this problem, we develop Context-Grounded Skill Internalization (CGSI). CGSI uses a sentence detector to identify unsupported references and then masks or rewrites the selected sentences before fine-tuning. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of CGSI and reveal two key findings. (i) Compared with directly fine-tuning with the skill removed, CGSI reduces CoMi at test time by 72.5-94.6% while preserving task success. (ii) Compared with existing reinforcement learning-based skill-internalization baselines, CGSI achieves comparable performance with substantially less training time. CGSI also significantly reduces processing costs compared with large-scale trajectory auditing and correction.
items.description_zh: 技能内化为智能体提供了一种从技能中学习有用行为的方法，并在推理时无需上下文中明确的指导即可使用它们。一种常见的方法是使用上下文中的技能生成演示轨迹，然后在删除技能的情况下根据其自己的轨迹微调同一模型。然而，这导致了一个问题，即模型可能会学习引用被删除的技能，我们将其称为上下文错位（CoMi）。在这项工作中，我们首先分析这个公共管道下与 CoMi 相关的代理行为。在 ALFWorld、WebShop 和 ARC-AGI-1 中，删除技能的微调始终会导致 CoMi：12.2-46.0% 的测试轨迹引用删除的技能。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了基于情境的技能内化（CGSI）。 CGSI 使用句子检测器来识别不支持的引用，然后在微调之前屏蔽或重写选定的句子。实验结果证明了 CGSI 的有效性并揭示了两个关键发现。 (i) 与删除技能的直接微调相比，CGSI 将测试时的 CoMi 减少了 72.5-94.6%，同时保持任务成功。 (ii) 与现有的基于强化学习的技能内化基线相比，CGSI 用���少的训练时间实现了可比的性能。与大规模轨迹审计和校正相比，CGSI 还显着降低了处理成本。
items.authors: Jinlin Liu, Yumeng He, Qihan Huang, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Han Peng

items.title: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation: Pixel as Code for Agentic Visual Creation
items.title_zh: Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation：像素作为代理视觉创作的代码
items.description: Visual creation demands expressive imagery together with precise control over text, layout, and structure. We introduce Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation, an agentic framework that connects these capabilities through Pixel as Code. Raster images are represented by learned discrete visual tokens, while structured artifacts use explicit programs. A shared generation-and-rendering interface connects these representations to visual feedback across images, vector graphics, webpages, and documents. A Nemotron-native harness coordinates planning and raster candidate selection, with targeted repair for editable structured and hybrid artifacts. To support this interface, we develop Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer, the autoregressive raster generator Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B, and the structured-code model family Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode. On approximately 178K images spanning six visual domains, our tokenizer improves reconstruction PSNR from 26.08 to 29.57 dB over Emu3.5 IBQ. It also provides 7.13x faster encoding and 10.93x faster decoding at batch size one on A100. In standalone evaluation, one Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode variant surpasses Kimi K3.1 Pro on the aggregate across Chart2Code, MMSVG, Design2Code, and Image2Struct. At the system level, the Nemotron-native configuration raises GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM from 31.71 to 52.56 using the same raster generator. With our best setting, Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation achieves performance competitive with GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana Pro across most benchmarks with available comparisons.
items.description_zh: 视觉创作需要富有表现力的图像以及对文本、布局和结构的精确控制。我们引入了 Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation，这是一个通过 Pixel as Code 连接这些功能的代理框架。光栅图像由学习的离散视觉标记表示，而结构化工件则使用显式程序。共享的生成和渲染界面将这些表示与图像、矢量图形、网页和文档之间的视觉反馈连接起来。 Nemotron 原生工具可协调规划和栅格候选选择​​，并针对可编辑的结构化和混合工件进行有针对性的修复。为了支持该接口，我们开发了 Nemotron-Labs-Image-Tokenizer、自回归光栅生成器 Nemotron-Labs-Image-30B-A3B 和结构化代码模型系列 Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode。在跨越六个视觉域的大约 178K 图像上，我们的分词器将重建 PSNR 从 Emu3.5 IBQ 的 26.08 dB 提高到 29.57 dB。它还在 A100 上以批量大小 1 提供 7.13 倍更快的编码和 10.93 倍更快的解码。在独立评估中，Nemotron-Labs-VisionCode 的一种变体在 Chart2Code、MMSVG、Design2Code 和 Image2Struct 方面的综合性能超过了 Kimi K3.1 Pro。在系统级别，Nemotron 原生配置使用相同的光栅生成器将 GenEval2 Soft-TIFA GM 从 31.71 提高到 52.56。在我们的最佳设置下，Nemotron-Labs-VisualCreation 在大多数可用比较的基准测试中实现了与 GPT Image 2 和 Nano Banana Pro 相媲美的性能。
items.authors: Guo Chen, Fuxiao Liu, Haoqin Tu, Yiyang Zhou, Andrew Tao, Bryan Catanzaro, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou, Huaxiu Yao, Didong Lu, Zongxia Li, Guilin Liu

items.title: Let Vision-Language Models Generate Images through Their Representations
items.title_zh: 让视觉语言模型通过其表示生成图像
items.description: Recent unified multimodal models aim to combine visual understanding and generation within a single model, yet effectively integrating the two capabilities remains challenging. Leveraging pretrained vision-language models offers a way to build on already learned multimodal knowledge, but making this knowledge effectively accessible to visual generation remains nontrivial. We find that a central challenge lies in the heterogeneous visual representations used for understanding and generation. To address this challenge, we introduce Integral, which converts a pretrained vision-language model into a unified multimodal model by constructing a shared visual representation space across the two capabilities. Integral implements this design through two complementary components. Abstraction Fusion constructs shared visual tokens by aggregating hierarchical representations from the frozen vision encoder, while Block-wise MoT introduces a lightweight generative stream that interacts with the vision-language model only at block boundaries. Our approach effectively preserves the pretrained understanding capability while extending it to strong visual generation. Controlled comparisons further demonstrate that sharing visual representations between understanding and generation substantially improves generative learning compared with using a separate visual representation space, despite comparable reconstruction fidelity. These results suggest that representations learned by pretrained vision-language models already provide an effective foundation for visual generation.
items.description_zh: 最近的统一多模态模型旨在将视觉理解和生成结合在单个模型中，但有效集成这两种功能仍然具有挑战性。利用预先训练的视觉语言模型提供了一种基于已经学习的多模态知识的方法，但使这些知识能够有效地用于视觉生成仍然很重要。我们发现一个核心挑战在于用于理解和生成的异构视觉表示。为了应对这一挑战，我们引入了 Integral，它通过跨两种功能构建共享的视觉表示空间，将预训练的视觉语言模型转换为统一的多模态模型。 Integral 通过两个互补的组件来实现这一设计。抽象融合通过聚合来自冻结视觉编码器的分层表示来构建共享视觉标记，而块式 MoT 则引入了仅在块边界与视觉语言模型交互的轻量级生成流。我们的方法有效地保留了预先训练的理解能力，同时将其扩展到强大的视觉生成。受控比较进一步表明，尽管重建保真度相当，但与使用单独的视觉表示空间相比，在理解和生成之间共享视觉表示极大地改善了生成学习。这些结果表明，通过预训练的视觉语言模型学习的表示已经为视觉生成提供了有效的基础。
items.authors: JB Kim, Byungwoo Jeon, Kyungmin Lee, Hyeonmo Kang, Cheonbok Park, Shinyoung Joo, Jinwoo Shin, Jeonghoon Kim

items.title: PixelOne: From Options to Pixels in a Single Forward for GUI Grounding
items.title_zh: PixelOne：从单一转发中的选项到像素，以实现 GUI 基础
items.description: GUI grounding requires precise clicks at low latency. Recent models such as GUI-Decisions and GUI-Swift predict coordinates in one forward pass using fixed global bins with local refinement. However, screenshot downsampling removes detail needed to locate small controls, while fixed bins cover larger pixel ranges at higher resolutions. We introduce PixelOne, which transfers spatial knowledge from a search teacher to a student that predicts clicks directly from screenshots at native resolution. The teacher uses VideoJEV's text-option scorer to select rows and columns and progressively zoom into candidate regions. The student inherits the teacher's parameters and matches its distributions over explored regions through spatial distillation alongside box supervision. At inference, the same decision head selects a visual token, and a lightweight pixel head predicts the click within it, all in one forward pass. A click-aligned loss encourages pixels inside the target box to score above those outside. Across four benchmarks, PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B achieves 83.8% mean accuracy, the highest among the evaluated single-forward grounders, with a mean latency of 0.43 s per target.
items.description_zh: GUI 接地需要低延迟的精确点击。最近的模型（例如 GUI-Decisions 和 GUI-Swift）使用带有局部细化的固定全局 bin 在一次前向传递中预测坐标。然而，屏幕截图下采样消除了定位小控件所需的细节，而固定箱以更高分辨率覆盖更大的像素范围。我们引入了 PixelOne，它将空间知识从搜索教师转移到学生，直接从原始分辨率的屏幕截图中预测点击。教师使用 VideoJEV 的文本选项评分器来选择行和列，并逐步放大候选区域。学生继承老师的参数，并通过空间蒸馏和盒子监督来匹配其在探索区域的分布。在推理时，同一个决策头选择一个视觉标记，并且一个轻量级像素头预测其中的点击，所有这些都在一次前向传递中。点击对齐损失会鼓励目标框内的像素得分高于目标框外的像素。在四个基准测试中，PixelOne-Pro-35B-A3B 的平均准确度为 83.8%，是评估的单前锋滚地球中最高的，每个目标的平均延迟为 0.43 秒。
items.authors: Kanghui Tian, Shuai Dong, Yuhan Zhu, Congcong Wang, Ji Zhao, Tianxiang Jiang, Zhixiong Zhang, Shengyuan Ding, Yi Wang, Jiaqi Wang, Yu Qiao

items.title: VideoJSON: A Minimal Harness Beats Purpose-Built Memory for Ultra-Long Video Understanding
items.title_zh: VideoJSON：最小的线束胜过专用内存，可实现超长视频理解
items.description: Answering questions over days or weeks of video requires searching for scattered clues across long timelines. Existing video agents rely on complex memory graphs and fixed retrieval pipelines, which restrict how the agent can search. We propose VideoJSON, a minimal harness for ultra-long video understanding that keeps the memory simple and lets a coding agent write its own search programs. During indexing, a vision-language model turns each minute of video into a single JSON record containing a dense caption and structured fields such as events, entities, places, and speech transcripts. At query time, the agent writes Python or Bash programs in a sandboxed container to filter, link, and read these records over multiple steps, without task-specific training or raw video access. On four ultra-long video benchmarks, VideoJSON with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash outperforms MAGIC-Video by 7.0, 20.0, and 24.75 points on EgoLifeQA, Ego-R1-Bench, and MM-Lifelong Week, and beats the best prior EgoMemReason score by 12.6 points. Across four policy models of increasing capability, VideoJSON's average score rises by up to 11.58 points over the weakest model, compared with at most 5.50 points for MAGIC-Video. Ablations show that both agentic code search and the structured JSON records drive these gains, while adding hourly summaries, extra tools, or video access changes the average score by less than 1.5 points. In addition, fine-tuning Qwen-3.5-Flash on 64 VideoJSON trajectories from an unrelated 100-hour livestream improves its MM-Lifelong scores by up to 8.25 points. Code will be open-sourced after publication.
items.description_zh: 在数天或数周的视频中回答问题需要在很长的时间内寻找分散的线索。现有的视频代理依赖于复杂的内存图和固定的检索管道，这限制了代理的搜索方式。我们提出了 VideoJSON，这是一种用于超长视频理解的最小工具，可以保持内存简单，并让编码代理编写自己的搜索程序。在索引过程中，视觉语言模型将每分钟的视频转换为单个 JSON 记录，其中包含密集的标题和结构化字段，例如事件、实体、地点和语音转录本。在查询时，代理在沙盒容器中编写 Python 或 Bash 程序，以通过多个步骤过滤、链接和读取这些记录，无需特定于任务的培训或原始视频访问。在四个超长视频基准测试中，使用 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 的 VideoJSON 在 EgoLifeQA、Ego-R1-Bench 和 MM-Lifelong Week 上的表现比 MAGIC-Video 高出 7.0、20.0 和 24.75 分，并且比之前最好的 EgoMemReason 得分高出 12.6 分。在四种能力不断增强的策略模型中，VideoJSON 的平均得分比最弱的模型提高了 11.58 分，而 MAGIC-Video 最多提高了 5.50 分。消融显示，代理代码搜索和结构化 JSON 记录都推动了这些进步，而添加每小时摘要、��外工具或视频访问则使平均分数改变了不到 1.5 分。此外，对来自不相关的 100 小时直播的 64 个 VideoJSON 轨迹进行微调 Qwen-3.5-Flash 将其 MM-Lifelong 分数提高了高达 8.25 分。代码发布后将开源。
items.authors: Wenqi Marshall Guo, Kuan-Hao Huang, Junda Chen, Hao Zhang

items.title: GlanceNav: Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation with Streaming Memory and Counterfactual Rewind
items.title_zh: GlanceNav：具有流式内存和反事实倒带的高效视觉和语言导航
items.description: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong policies for vision-and-language navigation (VLN). However, most of them encode a sample of past frames again at every decision and are trained on isolated decisions, so computation is redundant and the usable history is short. They also learn from their own mistakes through outcome rewards that give one scalar to a whole episode. We ask whether a navigator can encode each frame only once, at a constant cost per step, and still remember what matters and learn efficiently from its mistakes. We present GlanceNav, a streaming navigator built on a hybrid MLLM. Its Gated DeltaNet layers carry a recurrent state through the whole episode, while its attention layers keep a short window of recent observations and a small bank of keyframes, selected by how much each frame changes the recurrent state. This constant-size memory keeps the cost per step fixed and allows training on whole episodes with the same memory as at inference. Because the entire memory can also be copied in constant time, we further propose Counterfactual Rewind (CoRe), a reinforcement learning stage that rewinds a drifting rollout to its closest approach to the goal, lets an expert correct a few actions, and credits decisions by the resulting change in outcome. Trained only on the R2R-CE and RxR-CE training splits, with 1,000 instructions for reinforcement learning, a 4B GlanceNav reaches success rates of 71.9% and 73.6% on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen. On R2R-CE, it outperforms the strongest previous single-RGB method trained without external data by 9.1 points, while running at 104 ms per step.
items.description_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）已成为视觉和语言导航（VLN）的强有力的政策。然而，它们中的大多数在每个决策时都会再次对过去帧的样本进行编码，并针对孤立的决策进行训练，因此计算是多余的，可用的历史记录很短。他们还通过结果奖励从自己的错误中学习，为整个情节提供一个标量。我们询问导航器是否可以仅对每个帧进行一次编码，每步的成本恒定，并且仍然记住重要的事情并从错误中有效地学习。我们推出了 GlanceNav，这是一个基于混合 MLLM 构建的流式导航器���它的门控 DeltaNet 层在整个事件中携带一个循环状态，而它的注意力层保留最近观察的一个短窗口和一小堆关键帧，根据每个帧改变循环状态的程度进行选择。这种恒定大小的内存使每步的成本保持固定，并允许使用与推理时相同的内存对整个情节进行训练。由于整个记忆也可以在恒定时间内复制，因此我们进一步提出了反事实倒带（CoRe），这是一种强化学习阶段，可以将漂移的推出倒带到最接近目标的位置，让专家纠正一些动作，并根据结果的变化来做出决策。仅在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE 训练分割上进行训练，并使用 1,000 条强化学习指令，4B GlanceNav 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE val-unseen 上达到了 71.9% 和 73.6% 的成功率。在 R2R-CE 上，它比之前在没有外部数据的情况下训练的最强单 RGB 方法高出 9.1 个点，同时每步运行时间为 104 毫秒。
items.authors: Anh Dao, Quan-Dung Pham, Danh Vinh Le, Tuyen Pham Le, Quan Nguyen, Yuzhang Shang

items.title: Frontier models need only one text to unmask its human or AI author
items.title_zh: 前沿模型只需要一个文本就能揭开其人类或人工智能作者的面纱
items.description: Given a single text and a simple zero-shot prompt (no web access, tools, candidate lists, or writing samples), frontier models can answer "who wrote this?" at three increasingly specific levels: (1) whether an AI or human wrote it, (2) if an AI, which lab, and (3) if a human, often exactly who. The latest models (Claude Fable 5.2, GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 4 Carbon) match trained detectors like Pangram while also explaining their predictions in natural language, and Opus 5.5 names the correct lab for 98% of texts generated by models from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. Most strikingly, Fable 5.2 correctly names the author of 55% of 15K anonymous ICML 2020 reviews that were never made public, and identifies the username behind 69% of comments from active Redditors (with >500 posts over the last year). Accuracy depends on exposure to an author's writing in pretraining data and on reasoning effort, and simply asking a model how familiar it is with someone predicts whether it can identify their writing. For anyone who has published enough writing online, frontier models present a greater threat to anonymity than commonly assumed, and defenses are limited.
items.description_zh: 给定一个文本和一个简单的零样本提示（没有网络访问、工具、候选列表或写作样本），前沿模型可以回答“谁写了这个？”在三个日益具体的层面上：(1) 是人工智能还是人类编写的，(2) 如果是人工智能，那么是哪个实验室，(3) 如果是人类，通常是谁。最新的模型（Claude Fable 5.2、GPT-6.1 Sol、Gemini 4 Carbon）与 Pangram 等训练有素的检测器相匹配，同时还用自然语言解释了它们的预测，Opus 5.5 为 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 模型生成的 98% 的文本命名了正确的实验室。最引人注目的是，Fable 5.2 正确地指出了 15000 条从未公开的 ICML 2020 匿名���论中 55% 的作者，并识别了 69% 活跃 Reddit 用户评论背后的用户名（去年有超过 500 条帖子）。准确性取决于预训练数据中对作者写作的接触程度以及推理努力，并且只需询问模型与某人的熟悉程度即可预测它是否可以识别他们的写作。对于任何在网上发表了足够多文章的人来说，前沿模型对匿名的威胁比通常认为的更大，而且防御措施也是有限的。
items.authors: Atrey Desai, Deniz Bölöni-Turgut, Ty Brassington, Minjoon Choi, Jenna Russell, Rishanth Rajendhran, Bradley Emi, Hila Gonen, Hal Daumé III, John Wieting, Marzena Karpinska, Mohit Iyyer

items.title: Self-Supervised Dataset Distillation via Mutual Information Maximization
items.title_zh: 通过互信息最大化进行自监督数据集蒸馏
items.description: Dataset distillation (DD) aims to compress a large dataset into a small synthetic one that remains effective for training neural networks. Despite its success in supervised learning, DD remains underexplored in self-supervised learning (SSL), where distilled data must preserve the information needed to learn representations that remain consistent across augmentations. To bridge this gap, we introduce Mutual Information Prototype Alignment (MIPA), an efficient SSL dataset distillation approach that optimizes synthetic images to preserve augmentation-invariant information. Specifically, MIPA treats synthetic images as learnable prototypes and uses a frozen encoder to assign real samples to them based on feature similarity. A synthetic dataset that preserves such augmentation invariance should yield stable prototype assignments across multiple augmented views of the same real image. MIPA encourages this by maximizing mutual information between cross-view assignments while avoiding trivial solutions in which all real samples are assigned to only a few synthetic prototypes. Evaluations on image classification benchmarks show that synthetic data generated by MIPA yield higher-quality representations than existing distillation approaches while reducing time and storage demands during distillation.
items.description_zh: 数据集蒸馏（DD）旨在将大型数据集压缩为小型合成数据集，该数据集对训练神经网络仍然有效。尽管 DD 在监督学习方面取得了成功，但在自监督学习 (SSL) 方面仍然没有得到充分探索，其中蒸馏数据必须保留学习表示所需的信息，这些表示在增强过程中保持一致。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了互信息原型对齐（MIPA），这是一种有效的 SSL 数据集蒸馏方法，可优化合成图像以保留增强不变信息。具体来说，MIPA 将合成图像视为可学习的原型，并使用冻结编码器根据特征相似性将真实样本分配给它们。保留这种增强不变性的合成数据集应该在同一真实图像的多个增强视图上产生稳定的原型分配。 MIPA 通过最大化跨视图分配之间的互信息来鼓励这一点，同时避免将所有真实样本仅分配给少数合成原型的琐碎解决方案。对图像分类基准的评估表明，MIPA 生成的合成数据比现有的蒸馏方法产生更高质量的表示，同时减少了蒸馏过程中的时间和存储需求。
items.authors: Mohammad Hossein Moslemi, Mahdi Beitollahi, Zhimin Mei, Jiale Cai, Bissan Ghaddar, Boyu Wang

items.title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
items.title_zh: 测量和教导语言模型智能体对延迟后果采取行动
items.description: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. To study how experience improves those failures in an open model (Qwen3.8-27B), we used training-business records to identify operational rules and archived frontier quarters as starting states to continue from rather than transcripts to copy. On an unseen test business under identical evaluation instructions, the trained policy followed customer-protection commitments more consistently and reduced severe-loss quarters, while the additional profit benefit remained uncertain. Carrying those commitments through the quarter exposed the cost of fulfilling them, as early-quarter stocking habits left the buyer relying on emergency supply and a deteriorating supplier. The results separate recognizing a delayed effect, acting on it consistently, and coordinating surrounding decisions so that the response improves profit. SMB Bench connects these observations to a learning method by turning archived decisions and their consequences into reusable training experience.
items.description_zh: 语言模型代理越来越多地被要求运行持续的多天操作，而不是完成孤立的单轮任务。在日常运营中，今天的选择重塑了后来的观察结果和现金限制，因为空荡荡的货架隐藏着流失的上门需求，缺货的客户在几周后悄然缩减了未来的订单，而紧急购买则耗尽了营运资金。我们引入了 SMB Bench，这是一个经过校准的 90 天批发模拟器，具有 18 个因果配对任务和 859 个运行的前沿跟踪数据集，以询问哪些经验和学习信号使代理能够更好地注意到、归因和采取行动，以应对其自身决策在看不见的业务中的延迟后果。在 16 个前沿模型中，只有 3 个模型的表现优于固定购买规则；模型经常在笔记中记录相关诊断，而不会及时更改后来的购买，这表明诊断问题、改变行为和改进业务是独立的成就。为了研究经验如何改善开放模型（Qwen3.8-27B）中的这些失败，我们使用培训业务记录来识别操作规则并将存档的边境宿舍作为继续的起始状态，而不是复制成绩单。在相同评估指令下的未见过的测试业务中，训练有素的政策更一致地遵循客户保护承诺，并减少了严重亏损的季度，而额外的利润收益仍然不确定。在整个季度履行这些承诺暴露了履行这些承诺的成本，因为季度初的库存习惯使买家依赖紧急供应和不断恶化的供应商。结果将识别延迟效应、一致地采取行动以及协调周围决策以提高利润分开。 SMB Bench 通过将存档的决策及其后果转化为可重复使用的培训经验，将这些观察结果与学习方法联系起来。
items.authors: Shardul Bansal, Seth Schilbe, Jarrod Barnes
